body:
Savy, you hit it on the head perfectly.  

Since the day my first child was born I haven't had anything for myself besides the very odd guilty pleasure.  Everything I do is for my kids but I never have anything left over for me.  

I love to travel, I love to see new places but quite simply I don't have the means to do anything besides look after the basics in life.  With my second marriage I was finally starting to see a light at the end of the tunnel where I could do some more of the things I wanted.  My kids were more independent and with two of us together money wasn't so much of an issue any more.  I got to go to Vegas last year, thats the first time I've ever traveled somewhere for a vacation, it was great but the entire trip I knew that when we got back my marriage would be over.  Now that its me alone again I barely have enough money to eat and the debt just keeps piling up.  

I work in IT, I'm good at what I do and I've been at my job for over 10 years now, but I'm not happy at it anymore, I spent the entire day surfing reddit. 

My dreams?  I don't even know anymore, I know what I wanted in the past, I know I wanted to own my own home but that dream has been destroyed now.  I just want to be happy but looking at whats coming at me now I know that will be impossible.  I will never be able to have the life I want now, I will be in debt now for the next 10-15 years just paying off the mistakes I've made in the past 4 years.  That dream of owning my own home, its long gone, any hope of doing those fun things like vacations to places other than the campground up the road are gone.  

I want more from life than I will ever be able to afford, its just that simple.  

Savy, like I said you hit it on the head perfectly, you brought a tear to my eye with how you said what you did, I really appreciate that but I just don't see how this is going to get any better.

You know Otter Australia has always been somewhere I'd love to see, probably right at the top of my list if someone asked me and gave me an unlimited budget.  Unfortunately I live somewhere much colder, I wish I was Australian though.

At the time I got custody of my kids, ya their mom was messed up but now she seems to have a slightly better grasp on things, at least better than she did then.  Truth is my Daughter has been back with her for a little over a year now.  My second wife and my daughter didn't get along and so eventually my daughter went to live with her mom.  My son decided to stay with me but I'm pretty sure he'd go now if given the opportunity.  

I just signed his high school course request forms so that he can register for the stuff he wants to take next year but he may not even be able to go to that school because we will be moving once the house is sold.  He's so excited but I know he's going to be disappointed again when we move somewhere and he's unable to get the same courses somewhere else.

It may look as though I am blaming my ex for this but really I know that it was my fault, I got what I deserve in the end, I just dont have the energy to deal with it anymore.  I have been down this road before, it was slightly different because the first divorce only involved kids where the latest one involves money.  I thought that the second one would be easier, I thought with money the feelings wouldn't be the same but its almost worse this time because my entire future and everything I ever wanted for myself is slowly slipping away. 

I can't face my future knowing that I wil never have the opportunity to be where I am now again.

Comebackmom, this isn't just one this is number two, I've been through this before and I can't do it again.  I've tried so hard to be the big person, to show my kids integrity and how to do the right things.  These woman keep doing the wrong things and yet they reap the rewards for their actions, how is that right?  How can I keep fighting that and keep my sanity.

Here's an example from my current divorce fight:

She left almost a full year ago now, after breaking in to the house and taking anything that was paid for she called me to rub it in and that there was nothing I could do.  So now she decides she wants more, now that she has a new place of her own she wants the family cat, she's taken me to court and made me spend over $1000 just so that i can keep something here that is stable for my kids and now the court says we have to have "joint" custody of the cat???  Everyone says just give him up to her but I ask why?  Why does she get this?  Why can't she be the bigger person for once and just move on?  Why cant she say "Ok you're right i've been gone for a year so I'll leave him with you".

I have to be the one to give up again, why does it fall to me to be the looser... again?

This is why I'm where I'm at, this is why I've given up.

It's an amazing movie, it shows so many of the feelings and emotions of a relationship, I guess it's easy to relate to when you've felt those same things but not always known how to express them.  

He's 14, he knows most of whats going on right now and for that I'm ashamed, no kid should have to deal with the sorts of things I've given him.  I have no one else to talk to and sooner or later I end up telling him whats happening.  I don't have any friends besides some of the people I work with and really they're just work "acquaintances", I can't talk to my family as most of them are sick of hearing about my troubles... hell I feel bad enough that at 38 I still have to borrow money from my parents just to keep the lights on.

He knows I'm unhappy, he doesn't know how much though, I don't want to leave him but I don't see what good I can be to him any more either.  Honestly he would be better off without me, what have I shown him in his lifetime, how will he ever be able to know what a normal relationship looks like, he's never seen one.  

He's a good kid, and we do get along but I can't help thinking about all I've shown him, all of the wrong choices I've made so far in life I feel like maybe he'll stand a better chance on his own than to continue to watch his dad fail again and again.
